scientific.integrity: The threshold theorem is proved directly from the transport equation and delay characteristic equation. The numerical checker only replays the source parameters and sign tests; it is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the equations printed in Section 4.2 and the intended deterministic fixed-latency interpretation. It does not establish which equations were used in unpublished implementation code. It does not refit epidemiological data or claim an empirical quarantine recommendation.

title: The printed fixed-latency simulation attenuates infections before the delay
